001package com.fs.starfarer.api.util;
002
003import java.util.ArrayList;
004import java.util.HashSet;
005import java.util.List;
006import java.util.Set;
007
008public class TimeoutTracker<T> {
009
010        public static class ItemData<T> {
011                public T item;
012                public float remaining;
013        }
014        
015        private List<ItemData<T>> items = new ArrayList<ItemData<T>>();
016        transient private Set<T> set = new HashSet<T>();
017        
018        Object readResolve() {
019                set = new HashSet<T>();
020                for (ItemData<T> item : items) {
021                        set.add(item.item);
022                }
023                return this;
024        }
025        
026        Object writeReplace() {
027                return this;
028        }
029        
030        public void add(T item, float time) {
031                if (item == null) return;
032                getData(item).remaining += time;
033        }
034        
035        public void add(T item, float time, float limit) {
036                ItemData<T> d = getData(item);
037                if (time > 0 && d.remaining + time > limit) {
038                        time = Math.max(0, limit - d.remaining);
039                }
040                d.remaining += time;
041                if (d.remaining < 0) {
042                        d.remaining = 0;
043                }
044        }
045        
046        public void set(T item, float time) {
047                getData(item).remaining = time;
048        }
049        
050        public float getRemaining(T item) {
051                return getData(item).remaining;
052        }
053        
054        public void remove(T item) {
055                for (ItemData<T> d : items) {
056                        //if (d.item == item) {
057                        if (d.item.equals(item)) {
058                                items.remove(d);
059                                set.remove(item);
060                                return;
061                        }
062                }
063        }
064        
065        public List<T> getItems() {
066                List<T> list = new ArrayList<T>();
067                for (ItemData<T> d : items) {
068                        list.add(d.item);
069                }
070                return list;
071        }
072        
073        public void clear() {
074                items.clear();
075                set.clear();
076        }
077        
078        
079        private ItemData<T> getData(T item) {
080                for (ItemData<T> d : items) {
081                        //if (d.item == item) {
082                        if (d.item.equals(item)) {
083                                return d;
084                        }
085                }
086                ItemData<T> d = new ItemData<T>();
087                d.item = item;
088                d.remaining = 0;
089                items.add(d);
090                set.add(item);
091                return d;
092        }
093        
094        public void advance(float amount) {
095                List<ItemData<T>> remove = new ArrayList<ItemData<T>>();
096                for (ItemData<T> d : items) {
097//                      if (d.item instanceof CampaignEventListener) {
098//                              System.out.println("Remaining: " + d.remaining);
099//                      }
100                        d.remaining -= amount;
101                        if (d.remaining <= 0) {
102                                remove.add(d);
103                                set.remove(d.item);
104                        }
105                }
106                items.removeAll(remove);
107        }
108
109        public boolean contains(T item) {
110                return set.contains(item);
111//              for (ItemData d : items) {
112//                      if (d.item == item) {
113//                              return true;
114//                      }
115//              }
116//              return false;
117        }
118}
